mission_statement: Deliver reliable, scalable platform services that accelerate mission-critical application delivery across all operational environments.

working_well.title: CI/CD Pipeline Reliability
working_well.description: All 14 service pipelines green. Average build time 4m12s, down from 6m30s last period. Zero failed deployments to production.

working_well.title: Infrastructure-as-Code Coverage
working_well.description: Terraform coverage across all environments at 96%. All drift detection scans clean for 30 consecutive days.
working_well.evidence: Terraform state audit log shows 96% resource coverage. Drift scanner (runs 4x daily) zero findings since 2026-02-12.

needed.title: Dedicated DBA Support
needed.description: Database performance tuning expertise required. PostgreSQL query latency increasing month-over-month with no internal specialist.
needed.justification: P95 query latency up 40% MoM. Three production incidents in last 60 days traced to unoptimized queries. Team lacks deep PostgreSQL expertise.

needed.title: Additional Kubernetes Node Pool
needed.description: Current node pool at capacity limits. Need authorization and budget for expansion.
needed.justification: Current utilization at 87%. Projected to hit 95% within 3 weeks based on workload growth trend. No burst capacity available.

at_risk.title: Kubernetes Cluster Capacity
at_risk.description: Node pool at 87% utilization with workload growth accelerating. Scaling limits approaching within current allocation.
at_risk.mitigation: Requesting additional node pool allocation from cloud team (ND-002). Implementing pod resource limit optimization to buy 2 weeks. Evaluating spot instances for non-critical workloads.

at_risk.title: Secret Rotation Compliance
at_risk.description: 23% of service account credentials exceed 90-day rotation policy. Vault auto-rotation not yet configured for legacy services.
at_risk.mitigation: Manual rotation sprint scheduled for next week. Vault auto-rotation PR in review for 8 of 12 affected services. Remaining 4 legacy services need refactoring first.
